# LibreRun backend — resolved dependency lock. DO NOT EDIT BY HAND.
#
# Why this file exists: `backend/requirements.txt` states the versions we are
# willing to accept; this states the ones we actually tested. An unbounded
# requirement is how a routine image rebuild crossed an SDK major and took out
# every Anthropic-backed pipeline step, with no code or config change to point
# at. The image installs from this file so a rebuild cannot drift on its own.
#
# Regenerate with scripts/lock_requirements.sh after ANY edit to
# requirements.txt. That script resolves under Python 3.12 to match
# backend/Dockerfile, and universally so the lock stays valid on both amd64 and
# arm64 builders. Resolving on a different interpreter produces a lock the
# image cannot honour.
#
# Versions here were proven by the full backend suite: 674 passed, 4 skipped.
